names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Ermie»; the life page declines him as «Ermia» throughout.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ερμείας», with the rank word left off. The hymns on the same page inflect it «Ἑρμεία».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 31. мај ст. ст., „Свети мученик Ермије“ — Свети is not a rank and мученик is the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types`; the bare personal name is what is left. **Measured, and it is a fold of two told apart by the book’s own two days**: `foldchk.py` returns `[('hermes-apostle-of-dalmatia', 'sr')]` for «Ермије» — **the Prologue uses the identical string for the apostle Hermes of Romans 16:14 on its own Julian 8 April**, whose `serbian` row a reader of this wave wrote off the Охридски пролог за 21.04.2026, and who is an apostle, a bishop and a martyr of Dalmatia and not this old soldier of Comana. So the identical form is stored a second time on purpose and the two are told apart by their days and their ranks. **And the spelling is still the point**: this book writes „Ермије“ for this martyr and „Јерма“ for the apostle of its own previous entry, where doxologia writes «Ermie» for both and this folder and `hermas-31-may` consequently carry the identical Romanian form. **So the Serbian forms tell the two men apart where the Romanian ones cannot**, and that is why both were written on the same day. The Greek form here, «Ερμείας», is the same bare name.

The heading of the calendar’s name link, «Ермий Команский, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off; the day’s own line gives the bare «Ермия». `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «команскии ермии» before the write. THE DAY'S OTHER SAINT CARRIES THE SAME NAME IN A HYMN: the apostle Hermas's own troparion on this page addresses «Ермие», which is this man's vocative; the folders are told apart by their epithets and the hymn collision is recorded on the apostle's row.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 мая ст. ст. — «Мч. Ермия (II).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the name link heads him «Ермий Команский, мч.», of Comana, which is this folder’s display name, and its Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows keep him on the same Julian day. `dates` IS UNCHANGED: the folder holds «160 or 166», widened rather than chosen, and the Russian line prints «(II)» and its life sets the suffering «во время гонений при императоре Антонине Пии (138 - 161)», in the persecution under Antoninus Pius, which contains the earlier of the two years and not the later; nothing was narrowed on that, a reign being a bracket and not a year. `soldier` already stands and the Russian bears it out, «убеленный сединами воин», a soldier white with age. What the Russian adds and the paragraph carries: the governor Севастиан come to Cappadocia to carry out the order against the Christians and the honours and the emperor’s favour he offered, the beating that tore the skin from his face, the three days in the heated furnace and his walking out unhurt, the magician set to poison him and the two cups that did not kill him, the magician’s own conversion and beheading — baptised in his own blood — the sinews drawn out of him, the boiling tin, the eyes put out, the three days hanging head downward, the men sent to make sure he was dead who were struck blind with terror and whom he healed by laying his hands on them in the Name of Jesus Christ, the flaying of his whole body, and Севастиан cutting off his head with his own hand. THE CONVERTED MAGICIAN IS A NEW PERSON AND NO FOLDER WAS MADE FOR HIM: the calendar gives him no name, no day and no rank. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 31 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Ermie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ερμείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is the same man: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ερμείας, ζούσε στα Κόμανα της Καππαδοκίας», a soldier of long service brought before the duke Sebastian and beheaded in old age, which is the story doxologia's life tells. **This row is his and not the other Ermie's.** doxologia prints two men of the name on 31 mai and the corpus holds both — «Sfântul Apostol Ermie», the folder `hermas-31-may`, and this soldier of Comana — while saint.gr's day page prints only one Ερμείας, and its life is the soldier's. So nothing is owed to `hermas-31-may` from this day, and that is a reading of the two pages and not a statement about the apostle. `dates` are added where the folder had none. **Two hymns are stored, the proper apolytikion and the kontakion, both of which name him.** The page also prints a second apolytikion, «Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε», which is the general common of a martyr and names nobody; it is left in the source, and the megalynarion with it.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.06.2026 (31. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Ермије“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, on the same menologion 31/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of the 23 to 31 May is. **THE DEATH IS WIDENED BY SIX YEARS.** This folder holds `death` 160 off saint.gr’s «Τελικά τον αποκεφάλισαν … το 160 μ.Χ.» **The Prologue closes „Пострада свети Ермије 166. године за време цара Антонина“** — he suffered in the year 166, in the time of the emperor Antoninus. **Widened, not narrowed**: `death` becomes `earliest` 160, `latest` 166, display `160 or 166`. **The reign is used for nothing, and this folder’s existing `dates` note is why that matters** — it records that saint.gr names **two** emperors for the one persecution and gives Antoninus Pius’s regnal years under Marcus Aurelius’s name, so no reign was recorded as an interval there either. **This book naming Antoninus agrees with the first of saint.gr’s two and changes nothing**, 166 being stated outright. Six years, and `date-audit`’s `wide` did not move. **ALMOST THE WHOLE ENTRY IS ALREADY ON THE FOLDER.** The old soldier, the judge urging him in vain, the teeth beaten out with stones, the skin flayed off his face with a knife, the fiery furnace he rose from unharmed, the sorcerer’s poison that did him no harm, the sorcerer confessing Christ and being beheaded at once, the eyes gouged out, his answer to the judge, the hanging head-down, the men blinded by it and healed by his own prayer, the judge taking the knife himself, the Christians burying him secretly and the healings at his relics — **all of it is in the life already, in two other languages.** **New, and it is his sentence**: „Узми себи ове очи телесне, које гледају сујету света, ја имам очи срца, којима јасно видим светлост истиниту“ — take these bodily eyes to yourself, which look on the vanity of the world; I have the eyes of the heart, with which I see the true light clearly. **A third book confirming a long chain of torments word for word is worth recording and changes nothing else.** **`wonderworker` ADDED, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE ONE THIS WAVE HAS BEEN MAKING ALL WEEK.** „Свети Ермије призва их к себи, стави своје руке на њих и молитвом ка Господу поврати им вид“ — he called the blinded men to himself, laid his hands on them and by prayer to the Lord gave them back their sight. **The man is the subject of that wonder**, as on 24 May and 30 May, where the healings at his relics in the very next sentence are the relics’ — the reading that refused `wonderworker` to both Therapons on 25 and 27 May. **So the type is written on the living prayer and not on the relics**, and it is said here which sentence it came from. `wonderworker` is not in `PRECEDENCE`, so the page goes on reading *Martyr Hermias*. `martyr` and `soldier` are both corroborated — „Остарео као војник царски“. **THE SORCERER IS A MARTYRDOM THE BODY NARRATES AND HE GETS NO ROW, FOR WANT OF A NAME.** „Видећи то волх, толико се изненади да јавно исповеди Христа, због чега би одмах мачем посечен“ — a man converted by the failure of his own poison and beheaded for it, **which is exactly the test that owes a row** — but the entry calls him only волх, the sorcerer, no calendar read for this corpus keeps him, and by the coordinator’s third ruling nothing is minted for him. **He is the clearest owed row of the wave refused only for anonymity.** The judge and the emperor Antoninus gain nothing, the martyrdom belonging to him and not to the persecutor — the same Antoninus refused on 24 May. `related` stays empty. No `locations`, although Comana is in the display name and the entry names no place at all. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the three hymns on this folder stay.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Ermie, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Ermie; the text is the common of a martyr with his name set in it.

english.text: Thy martyr Hermias, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength he overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Χριστῷ στρατευσάμενος, τῷ Βασιλεῖ τοῦ παντός, γενναίως διέκοψας, τὰς παρατάξεις ἐχθρῶν. Ἑρμεία πανένδοξε· σὺ γὰρ ἐγκαρτερήσας, πολυτρόποις αἰκίαις, ἤθλησας ἐν τῷ γήρᾳ, ὡς τοῦ Λόγου ὁπλίτης· ὧ πρέσβευε Ἀθλοφόρε, σώζεσθαι ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Ερμείας»; the second is the general common of a martyr and is left there

english.text: Having taken service with Christ, the King of all, thou didst bravely cut through the ranks of the enemy, O all-glorious Hermias; for having endured torments of every kind, thou didst contend in thine old age as a soldier of the Word. Intercede, O prize-bearer, that all may be saved.

hymns.text: Τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὸ ὄνομα, ὁμολογήσας εὐτόνως, καὶ σφοδρῶν κολάσεων, ὑπενεγκὼν τὰς ὀδύνας, ᾔσχυνας, τῶν παρανόμων τὰς ἐπινοίας· ἔδειξας, τῆς εὐσεβείας πᾶσι τὸ κράτος· διὰ τοῦτό σε Ἑρμεία, ὁ Ἀθλοθέτης Λόγος ἐδόξασε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιος Ερμείας»

english.text: Having confessed the name of Christ with vigour, and borne the pains of violent punishments, thou didst put to shame the devices of the lawless and show to all the strength of godliness; and for this the Word, the bestower of the prize, has glorified thee, O Hermias.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Ермий/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего:/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь мученика Ермия», глас 4 — the common of a single martyr with his name set into it

english.text: Thy martyr Hermias, O Lord, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from thee, our God; for having thy strength he cast down the tormentors and broke the feeble boldness of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Иже по Христе усердно подвизався,/ в сединах доблих мужество стяжа,/ мучениче Ермее,/ беззаконных злоумышления поправ/ Христовою силою,/ от чаровных напоений невредим пребысть, зовый:// Бог есть со мною, и никтоже на мя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 мая ст. ст., «Кондак мученика Ермия», глас 6 — proper to him, and it names both the grey hairs and the poisoned draughts his own life turns on

english.text: Having striven earnestly for Christ, thou didst gain a valiant manhood in thy grey hairs, O martyr Hermias; and trampling down the evil designs of the lawless by the power of Christ, thou didst remain unharmed by the enchanted draughts, crying: God is with me, and no one against me.

death.note: Widened, not narrowed, because two books disagree by six years. saint.gr gave 160, which this folder held alone: «Τελικά τον αποκεφάλισαν χαρίζοντας του το στέφανο της δόξας το 160 μ.Χ.» Охридски пролог за 13.06.2026 (31. мај ст. ст.): „Пострада свети Ермије 166. године за време цара Антонина“. The reign is used for nothing — saint.gr names two emperors for the one persecution and gives Antoninus Pius’s regnal years under Marcus Aurelius’s name — and 166 is stated outright. Neither book gives a year of birth, only that he was already old.
